veadotube.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to veadotube.

variables.veadotube.instance: The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini)
variables.veadotube.instanceId: veadotube's own id for that window

veadotube.disconnected.description: Runs when the connection to veadotube drops, for example because you closed it.

variables.veadotube.instance: The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini)
variables.veadotube.instanceId: veadotube's own id for that window

veadotube.stateChanged.description: Runs when your avatar changes to another state in veadotube, whether you clicked it, used a hotkey, or an action changed it.

fields.state: Only react when the avatar changes to one of these states. Type their names as in veadotube, separated by commas. Leave empty for any state.

variables.veadotube.instance: The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini)
variables.veadotube.instanceId: veadotube's own id for that window
variables.stateId: That state's id (the same as its name in new versions)
variables.previousState: The state that was showing before
variables.nodeName: The node that changed (avatar state in veadotube mini)

veadotube.switchChanged.description: Runs when push-to-talk (or another on/off node in full veadotube) turns on or off.

fields.node: Only react to these nodes, for example push-to-talk. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.
fields.state: Only react when it turns On, only when it turns Off, or Any.

variables.veadotube.instance: The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini)
variables.veadotube.instanceId: veadotube's own id for that window
variables.nodeName: The node that changed, for example push-to-talk
variables.value: True when it is now on, false when off

veadotube.numberChanged.description: Runs when a Number node you exposed in full veadotube changes.

fields.node: Only react to these Number nodes, by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.

variables.veadotube.instance: The name of the veadotube that is connected
variables.veadotube.instanceId: veadotube's own id for that window
variables.min: The lowest value of its range, if it has one
variables.max: The highest value of its range, if it has one

veadotube.changeState.description: Changes which avatar state veadotube shows, for example a surprised face when someone raids.

fields.mode: Switch to this state, show it on top (and remember the one before), take it off, toggle it, pick a random state, or go back to the first state.
fields.state: The state's name exactly as in veadotube. Not needed for "Back to the first state". For Random, type several names separated by commas, or leave it empty to pick from all states.
fields.node: Leave empty. Only full veadotube users with several State Events nodes type a node name here.
fields.seconds: Seconds until the state goes back: a state shown on top is taken off, a switched or random state goes back to the one before. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.instance: Leave empty for the connected veadotube. To control another open veadotube at the same time (for example veadotube and veadotube mini, or two minis), type its name or address.

variables.veadotube.state: The state that was asked for

veadotube.setSwitch.description: Turns veadotube's push-to-talk on, off or the other way round. With push-to-talk on, your avatar talks even without the mic.

fields.state: On, Off, or Toggle (the opposite of now).
fields.node: Leave empty for push-to-talk. Full veadotube users can type the name of another on/off (Boolean) node.
fields.seconds: Seconds until it is set back, like holding a button down. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.instance: Leave empty for the connected veadotube. To control another open veadotube at the same time (for example veadotube and veadotube mini, or two minis), type its name or address.

variables.veadotube.value: True when it was turned on, false when off (empty if unknown)

veadotube.setNumber.description: Sets a number in full veadotube, for nodes you exposed yourself (veadotube mini has none).

fields.node: The name of the Number node in veadotube.
fields.add: Tick to add the number to the current one instead of replacing it.
fields.min: With Highest value: the node's range, shown as a graph in veadotube. Leave both empty to keep the range the node already has.
fields.max: With Lowest value: the node's range.
fields.instance: Leave empty for the connected veadotube. To control another open veadotube at the same time (for example veadotube and veadotube mini, or two minis), type its name or address.

variables.veadotube.number: The node's value afterwards, when veadotube reports it

veadotube.getState.description: Finds out which avatar state is showing, so later steps can use it.

fields.node: Leave empty for veadotube mini's avatar state.
fields.instance: Leave empty for the connected veadotube. To control another open veadotube at the same time (for example veadotube and veadotube mini, or two minis), type its name or address.

variables.veadotube.states: All state names, separated by commas
variables.veadotube.stateId: veadotube's id for the state showing now
variables.veadotube.stateImage: The picture of the state showing now, as a data: address an overlay can show (connected veadotube only)
variables.veadotube.number.<name>: The value of each Number node, by its name (full veadotube)

veadotube.getNumber.description: Reads a Number node's value (full veadotube), so later steps can use it.

fields.instance: Leave empty for the connected veadotube. To control another open veadotube at the same time (for example veadotube and veadotube mini, or two minis), type its name or address.

variables.veadotube.numberMin: The lowest value of its range, if it has one
variables.veadotube.numberMax: The highest value of its range, if it has one

veadotube.resetNode.description: Clears push-to-talk (or another on/off node) or a Number node back to no value, as if nothing had set it.

fields.type: Which kind of node to reset.
fields.node: The node's name. Leave empty for push-to-talk.
fields.instance: Leave empty for the connected veadotube. To control another open veadotube at the same time (for example veadotube and veadotube mini, or two minis), type its name or address.
